description: This Java class 'PdfSurveyServices' provides services for handling PDF-based surveys, including building surveys from PDFs, extracting and setting form fields, generating survey response PDFs, and managing survey questions and answers within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PdfSurveyServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services for PDF-based survey creation, response handling, and form field management within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: buildSurveyFromPdf
methods.description: Creates a new survey and survey questions from a PDF form, extracting form fields and storing them as survey questions.

methods.name: buildSurveyResponseFromPdf
methods.description: Builds a survey response by extracting answers from a PDF form and storing them as survey response answers.

methods.name: getAcroFieldsFromPdf
methods.description: Extracts form fields and their values from a PDF form.

methods.name: setAcroFields
methods.description: Sets form field values in a PDF form based on provided data.

methods.name: buildPdfFromSurveyResponse
methods.description: Generates a PDF document representing a survey response.

methods.name: buildSurveyQuestionsAndAnswers
methods.description: Retrieves survey questions and corresponding answers for a given survey response.

methods.name: setAcroFieldsFromSurveyResponse
methods.description: Populates PDF form fields with answers from a survey response and optionally outputs the modified PDF.

methods.name: getInputByteBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves the input PDF as a ByteBuffer from either a file or content resource, used internally by other methods.
